title: Subadditivity of matrix rank
statement:
Let $X$ be any index set and $Y$ a finite index set, and let $A, B \in \bbr^{X \times Y}$ be real matrices with rows indexed by $X$ and columns indexed by $Y$. Then
\[
  \mathrm{rank}(A + B) \le \mathrm{rank}(A) + \mathrm{rank}(B).
\]
hypotheses_covered: A, B real matrices indexed by X and Y
Y is a finite index set
replaced:
For any two matrices $A, B \in \mathbb{R}^{X \times Y}$,
\[
  \mathrm{rank}(A + B) \le \mathrm{rank}(A) + \mathrm{rank}(B).
\]
